text:
Type: abstract flatwoven rug
Use: accenting a floor area; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: modern, mid-century modern, contemporary
Materials: flatwoven fibers, fringed ends
Colors: cream, warm grey, charcoal, teal, orange accent
Shape: rectangular, cubist-inspired blocks of triangles and angled shapes, short fringe on both ends, thin and flat, medium size
Feel: artistic, playful, graphic
Goes with: light wood floors, teal or white walls, orange accents; modern or mid-century rooms

product.name: Rivet Flatwoven Cubist-Inspired Rug, 4' x 6', Cream and Gray with Orange
product.description: This contemporary rug will add texture, depth, and color wherever you have a bare floor or need to create visual interest in a room. Though the pattern is bold, the blues, grays, and oranges of the soft wool-and-cotton pile are classic colors that will blend with almost any color scheme. 4'W x 6'L 71% wool, 24% cotton, 5% Lurex Transitional design in colors that can be paired with any decor Pair with rug pad (sold separately)
